title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, information campaigns, access constraints, and policy enforcement.

interactions.name: social_peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other’s mask adoption through their social ties; adoption probability updates via peer behavior and norms.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Media and government disseminate messages that update perceived benefits/costs and risk; misinformation can counteract official guidance.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Government sets mandates; locations enforce via admission checks and fines, affecting compliance decisions.

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: Individuals purchase or receive masks from retailers or government distribution, constrained by inventory, price, and subsidies.

interactions.name: workplace_school_entry
interactions.description: Locations admit or deny entry based on mask status, reinforcing adoption through access incentives.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household norms and discussions shape member attitudes and adoption states.

interactions.name: supply_distribution
interactions.description: Government directly supplies masks to households or individuals (e.g., free kits) influencing access.

interactions.name: risk_feedback_optional
interactions.description: Exogenous or modeled disease prevalence shifts personal risk perception, affecting adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate observed at each location type.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across income or regions (e.g., Gini coefficient).

metrics.name: policy_cost
metrics.description: Total government cost for subsidies and enforcement net of fine revenue.

metrics.name: supply_outage_days
metrics.description: Number of days retailers experience zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: mask_purchase_rate
metrics.description: Daily rate of successful mask acquisitions by individuals.

metrics.name: misinformation_impact
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to misinformation exposure compared to a counterfactual without it.
